name: ToolPermission
summary: What each tool may do, without asking again.

a11y.apg: radiogroup — the three-way choice is a SegmentedControl, which is Base UI's radio group (ADR-0016)
a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 29/08/2026 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). This ficha comes from the lineage that did not have check 30, so it declared keys with no measurement behind them — the merge of the two lineages on 29/08/2026 is what surfaced it. Confirmed: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown and Space. ArrowUp, ArrowDown and Space were delivered and NOT declared before this measurement. They are not this component's own work: the three-way choice is a SegmentedControl, which is the engine's radio group since ADR-0016, and the ficha was declaring a subset of what that pattern ships. Declared and not confirmed in this snapshot: Home and End. Absence of an observable change does not prove absence of effect: a generic DOM snapshot can prove a key does something, never that it does not.

props.name: tools
props.description: One row per tool. `scope` sits NEXT TO the name, never hidden: "read" and "read /etc" are different permissions, and granting the second thinking it is the first is the defect this component exists to prevent.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires when a permission changes. The three-way choice is a SegmentedControl, so arrows move AND select, with Home and End — writing three toggle buttons here would redo by hand the pattern ADR-0016 rejected.
